earliestPhaseSemantics: The first phase in which the scenario is mandatory as part of its full gate. An independently runnable scenario may be activated earlier as an infrastructure smoke test.
phaseExecutionPolicy: Phase 5 activates all 39 RUN rows, retaining the 23 historical Phase 3/4 profile IDs and requiring the 16 reviewed Phase 5 profiles acquired in one complete controlled observation. completion-complete remains the sole NOT_APPLICABLE row and its profile remains null.

scenarios.name: server-stateless
requiredFixtureRegistrations: framework-owned server/discover
truthful tools, prompts, resources, and subscription capabilities
progress-reporting tool
MRTR tools
scenarios.rationale: The public fixture and standalone contract provide the scenario's progress, capability-diagnostic, valid embedded-elicitation, logging, MRTR, and truthful resource-subscription registrations. The controlled complete Phase 5 observation cleanly produced 28 SUCCESS and the two exact reviewed mutable-list SKIPPED occurrences, with automatic wire counts 0/0. That reviewed expected profile is active and matched the fresh exact 39-scenario Phase 5 development verification; release-candidate provenance remains separately open.
